annotations.title: Get logo files or a brand kit

description: Use this when the person is happy with a Webba design and wants its files. 'logo' is the logo only: a pack of 24 logo files. 'kit' is the brand kit with the logo: roughly 100 to 110 files built around that logo: logo files, social posts, print files, a brand guide and a simple website, with sample words and pictures to replace. Returns a private link that expires after 24 hours. It opens a Webba page where the person ticks a box to agree to the Terms of Service and presses Download; nothing else counts as their agreement. A completed download counts toward a limit of 10 logo packs and 2 brand kits per person in any 24 hours; the same files again don't count, and failed downloads don't. Pass the chosen design's state exactly as a Webba result gave it, such as one of find_designs' results. When the person asks you to choose one of the designs shown, picking one counts as their choice. When they ask for the brand kit or the complete kit, use type 'kit'. Do not use this before a design has been shown, which comes from find_designs or start_build.

state.description: The design's state exactly as returned by the last Webba tool result. Don't edit it by hand.

type.description: 'logo' for the logo only, or 'kit' for the brand kit with the logo.
